name: The Day It All Broke
why_it_works: A specific date makes a story feel true before a single detail lands. People root for anyone who hit bottom and chose something; the business becomes the proof of that choice, so buying from it feels like joining the comeback.

hook.pattern: Open on a real date and the word 'broke'. A date promises a true story; 'broke' promises stakes.
examples: March 3rd, 2019. The day it all broke.
One Tuesday in {{turning_date}} changed everything here.
I can tell you the exact day I almost quit.

variables.name: turning_date
variables.description: The real date things broke, as people say it

variables.name: old_life
variables.description: What the founder was doing before, in a few words
variables.example: pulling double shifts at a job I hated

variables.name: breaking_point
variables.example: they cut my hours with a text message

variables.name: decision
variables.example: I spent my last savings on a used espresso machine

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets for coming in
variables.example: first cup on us this week

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a wall calendar or phone lock screen showing {{turning_date}}, inside {{brand}}'s empty space before opening, cold blue morning light, shallow focus on the date

beats.purpose: set the character and the before

visual.prompt: Vertical portrait of the founder of {{brand}} from behind, in the old setting of {{old_life}}, muted desaturated tones, overhead fluorescent light, slightly tired posture
Slow push-in on a single object that captures {{breaking_point}}, dim room, one hard side light, dust in the air, vertical 9:16
Close-up of the founder's hands doing the first act of {{decision}}, such as signing a lease or unlocking a door, warm practical light, vertical framing

beats.voiceover: That decision became {{brand}}. And it still runs on that day.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot inside {{brand}} today, busy and warm, golden hour light through the windows, camera slowly drifts forward past customers

beats.voiceover: Come see what that day built. {{offer}}.

cta: Come see what that day built. {{offer}}.

craft.technique: Date-stamped origin with a single turn
craft.notes: Use one true date and one physical object for the breaking point. Keep the before short and dull in color so the warm present-day shot feels like a release. Only one decision, never a list.

do_not: Invent hardship that did not happen
Spend more than 4 seconds on the sad part
Bury the business name until the last frame
